subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed through plugin-hook metadata only, untrusted per-turn prompt context, or persisted session metadata?
rationale: The extraction path is bounded, but the requested click id is ad-attribution data and the issue asks for model/session visibility, so automation should not choose the exposure and retention boundary.

options.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Expose selected CTWA fields only to opted-in WhatsApp/plugin hook metadata so a Conversions API plugin can consume them without putting click ids in prompts or durable session state by default.

options.title: Untrusted prompt context
options.body: Expose selected CTWA fields as untrusted structured context for the current turn when maintainers accept model/transcript visibility.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store first-touch CTWA attribution on session state after defining retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
recommendation.body: Expose selected CTWA fields only to opted-in WhatsApp/plugin hook metadata so a Conversions API plugin can consume them without putting click ids in prompts or durable session state by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses WhatsApp hook metadata and security-sensitive exposure, and Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history on the adjacent WhatsApp/hook/security surface.
